longstride.name: Long Charge
longstride.desc: Reckless Charge goes 40% farther and hits 30% harder.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.desc: Flashfire's trail burns twice as long.

hearth.name: Hearth
hearth.desc: Kindle also heals him for 25 and lasts 4 seconds longer.

mirror.name: Mirror Dome
mirror.desc: The Dome reflects bullets back as your own.

firebash.name: Burning Leap
firebash.desc: Heroic Leap lands in a ring of fire that keeps burning.

dawn.name: Second Dawn
dawn.desc: The Solar Lance revives a fallen partner it touches.

brightflare.name: Bright Lance
brightflare.desc: The Solar Lance is 40% wider and its power-up lasts 8 seconds.

twinstep.name: Twin Step
twinstep.desc: Step's light heals twice as much and lasts longer.
